items.q: Drew Brown, yeah. And he was the youngest guy into the bebop thing.

ctx.x: Drew Brown, yeah. And he was the youngest guy into the bebop thing. Everywhere we played, I used to follow him around – with him. We got to be really friendly. Mack Simpkins. He was a bad guy.
What about Clark? You just mentioned Fats.
